definitions: Each of a pair of devices attached to each side of a horse's saddle, in the form of a loop with a flat base to support the rider's foot.
A U-shaped or ring-shaped device forming part of a mechanism or used as a support or clamp.
examples: She adjusted her stirrups before mounting the horse.
The stirrup iron was cold against his boot.
The surgeon used a stirrup to hold the patient's leg.
